original_title: Wait for Hormuz Deal Stretches on as Iran Says Terms Must Be Met
title: Wait for Hormuz Deal Stretches on as Iran Says Terms Must Be Met
original_summary: The wait dragged on for an Iranian deal with Oman on the Strait of Hormuz, with the Islamic Republic warning the US that any pact wouldn’t lead to an immediate reopening of the crucial energy chokepoint.

original_title: Many of Iran’s demands ‘already agreed to’ by the US in June MoU
title: Many of Iran’s demands ‘already agreed to’ by the US in June MoU
original_summary: Iran on Saturday issued a list of demands for the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, which have been characterised as “new” preconditions. Reporting from Washington, FRANCE 24’s Fraser Jackson notes that many of the demands were “already agreed to by the US in the [Islamabad] Memorandum of Understanding that was signed back in June” between Iran and the US. “The difficulty was that the language then was quite broad.”
